notes: Neff=3.044 is a modern Standard Model theory benchmark; 3.046 reproduces the historical Planck convention.
For an exact massive-neutrino background evolve the Fermi-Dirac energy integral separately from cold+baryonic matter and massless radiation.
A constant effective radiation term with all neutrinos massless plus a matter density containing massive neutrinos is only an approximation and must be labeled.

implementationGuardrails: Use one fully labeled default model; do not average mutually model-dependent inferences.
Published marginal errors do not provide a multivariate covariance. Independent Gaussian draws are a sensitivity experiment, not a posterior forecast.
Keep observationally motivated CPL presets distinct from future scenarios. w(a)=w0+wa(1-a) is phenomenological; at a>1 it extrapolates outside observed redshift and can diverge as a grows.
An ensemble fraction reaching a fate under chosen sliders/priors is not an observed probability of the Universe's fate.
Derive Omega_DE by closure for the implemented components rather than forcing rounded observational densities to sum exactly.
